zoe: Heads-up: found broken Python quickstart during onboarding call — the page 404s and the code uses `Client.generate()` which doesn't exist in latest SDK. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/python

noah: Can you paste the snippet and error?

zoe: Snippet from the page:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this")
print(resp)
```
Traceback: AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'generate'
Also mypy flagged: "Client" has no attribute "generate" and coroutine was not awaited in other examples.

jess: Oof. Docs were switched to the async-first SDK last month and looks like an old sync fragment leaked into the quickstart. We also changed the top-level import names.

noah: Short term: add a redirect so external links don't 404. Mid-term: update quickstart to an async example and add a tiny test that runs the sample in CI.

jess: Proposed async snippet that matches current packaging:```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY") as client:
        result = await client.completions.create(prompt="Write a haiku about GPUs")
        print(result.choices[0].text)

asyncio.run(main())
```
This uses context-manager and awaits. Matches types and avoids unclosed session warnings.

zoe: That looks good. Also flag: type hints for AsyncClient.__aenter__ are currently Any in 0.9.0 which triggers strict mypy. We should annotate returning AsyncClient in the package.

noah: I'll open a small typing PR to include __aenter__: -> "AsyncClient" and __aexit__ accordingly. Also add a `py.typed` and update packaging so types are picked up.

docs-bot: link-check job failed: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/links/5588 — /quickstart/python returned 404.

noah: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/328 with traces and env. Attaching failing CI logs.

jess: I'll prepare PR to update docs page to async snippet + add redirect rule in the docs site for the old URL. Also adding a docs smoke test that spins up a venv and runs the quickstart snippet (non-networking, mocks the client).

zoe: Thanks — this caused friction for a new hire during onboarding so higher priority please.

noah: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/497 (docs + types + CI smoke). Assigning to jess for review.

jess: Review in progress. Will request changes if typing import paths need adjusting.

zoe: Confirmed the CI error link — thanks for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
